services.desc: Jan Albers, Fiona Banner, Uta Barth, Fiona Connor, Petra Cortright, Judy Ledgerwood, Philippe Parreno, Diana Thater & Rirkrit Tiravanija Life’s a riot at 25 celebrates 1301PE’s storied history through ephemera over the past 25 years. When 1301 was founded in 1992 the artist poster was central to the overall thinking of the gallery. Within this format the artist was free to extend the exhibition through ephemera. 1301PE is pleased to present the newest exhibition by MacArthur Fellow Uta Barth, on view from March 11 to April 22, 2017.
